article.title: Congo's Elite Struggle for Power While Imperialist Control and Violence Decimate the Country
article.author: bareditors
article.content: Congo's Elite Struggle for Power While Imperialist Control and Violence Decimate the Country Authors Black Agenda Radio with Margaret Kimberley bareditors Fri, 10/16/2026 - 04:45 Joseph Kabila, former president of the Democratic Republic of Congo, named himself president of the Front for the Rebuilding of the Nation. He is now formally allied with M23, the Rwanda-backed militia that has terrorized eastern provinces for many years. In addition, Ebola virus disease continues to spread in the DRC. Maurice Carney is the executive director of Friends of the Congo , and he joins us from Washington to provide analysis. Africa Congo M23 Rwanda Ebola US Imperialism
